title: Prove the narrow waist with one real adapter and a reference evaluator
question: Can a captured operational state from a real timing implementation be mapped deterministically into TimeSync TimeState and profile applicability, with every assumption and unsupported condition made explicit?
why_now: The archive has a mature semantic corpus and broad internal consistency checks, but it still validates mostly pre-authored TimeSync objects. The next uncertainty is not another field relationship; it is whether the six-field boundary survives contact with real observations without smuggling protocol-specific state into the core.
working_hypothesis: A chrony snapshot is the smallest useful first proof because tracking, sources, and sourcestats expose offset, dispersion, delay, reachability, leap status, and estimator state from which a conservative bounded interval and posture can be derived. The mapping should remain adapter-specific while the emitted TimeState stays protocol-neutral.
acceptance_criteria: Add a sanitized or reproducibly generated chrony tracking/sources/sourcestats capture with its collection time and command/version context.
Add a parser that produces a typed observation object without producing TimeState yet.
Add a reference evaluator that maps the observation to TimeState plus one profile assessment using a documented, conservative uncertainty rule.
Add positive and negative golden tests, including stale capture, unsynchronized/leap-not-normal state, missing fields, and excessive root distance.
Emit a machine-readable explanation that identifies each source observation and policy rule used in the decision.
Declare leap-second, leap-smear, timescale, and monotonic-anchor limitations explicitly; unsupported cases must fail closed.
Do not add a seventh TimeState field unless the adapter/evaluator proof demonstrates an irreducible semantic gap.
non_goals: Do not add another transparency, authority, witness, receipt, or lifecycle ontology during this frontier.
Do not claim cryptographic verification unless real signature verification is executed.
Do not treat a single chrony adapter as proof of NTP, PTP, or cross-vendor interoperability.
next_best_moves: Run tools/chrony_capture.py on a host with chronyd/chronyc available and retain the real capture envelope including sourcestats, authdata, and ntpdata.
Add an ntpq live-capture envelope analogous to the chrony capture envelope for hosts with ntpd/NTPsec available.
Replay real chrony and ntpq captures through their evaluators, then through tools/multisource_adjudicator.py, and compare outputs against the fake/replay fixtures.
Add true NTS verification only when packet/session evidence can be checked cryptographically; reported management text is not enough.
Compare a PTP operational-state source before expanding the observation vocabulary or claiming cross-domain interoperability.
Produce a slim distribution once at least one live adapter path is exercised against a real host and stable.
stop_condition: Close FT-0121 when one real adapter can be replayed end to end into a deterministic, explained TimeState/profile decision and independently tested failure cases, or when the attempt produces a documented counterexample showing that the six-field core is insufficient.
